transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I guess… mostly my sleep has just gotten really off lately. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but I’ll be up half the night with my mind kind of running, or I wake up way too early and feel like I didn’t really rest at all. It’s been starting to bother me enough that I thought I should come in.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot during the day?

I don’t know if I’d call it worrying a lot, exactly. I mean, I have normal stuff on my mind during the day, like work and things I need to get done, but I haven’t really noticed it being constant worry… if that makes sense.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

A little, yeah… I mean, I don’t want to be dramatic, but lately I’ll wake up with this heavy, empty feeling. Like, I’ll be sitting in my condo — which I worked really hard for — and instead of feeling proud or comfortable, I just kind of feel like I could cry. If that makes sense.
Do you feel anxious?

Um… not really anxious, I don’t think. I mean, I get a little keyed up sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it feels like anxiety exactly. Maybe I’m not describing it right, but it doesn’t feel like I’m scared or panicking or anything.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Yeah… I guess not as much. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but I stopped going to my salsa class, and I usually really liked that. And my paints are still sitting out on the table at home, but I just look at them and… nothing. Like they belong to somebody else or something. Is that kind of what you mean?
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um… I think it’s been around for maybe five months? Not every second is terrible, so I don’t want to overstate it, but that kind of depressed, guilty fog has been there for a while. It got a lot worse after I bought the condo, though… which feels silly to say, because that should’ve been a good thing, right?
Are there any activities that you still enjoy doing?

I mean… I still try to enjoy things, but it’s not really landing the same. Salsa used to be fun for me, and I just kind of stopped going. And I have my paints out at home, but I’ll look at them and feel… nothing, almost like they’re somebody else’s stuff. I don’t know if that counts as not enjoying things, but that’s kind of how it’s been.
Have you had any periods in the past five months where you felt better for at least a couple of weeks?

Not really… I mean, I’ve had maybe a day here or there where I thought, okay, maybe I’m fine, but I don’t think it’s ever lifted for a couple weeks. That depressed, guilty fog has kind of been hanging around the whole five months, just… it got a lot worse after I bought the condo. I hope that answers what you’re asking.
Have you ever felt this depressed before the past five months?

I’m not totally sure… I mean, I’ve definitely had sad stretches before, like anyone, but I don’t know that I’d call them this bad or this long. Maybe I brushed things off at the time, so it’s hard to compare. Does that make sense?
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt depressed like this?

I don’t think so… not like this, at least. I’ve had times where I was down or stressed, but I’m not sure I’d say more than one period that felt the same as this. I might be forgetting or minimizing it, but… this feels different enough that I’d say no, I don’t think so.
Is this the first time in your life you've felt this level of depression?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I’ve felt down before, but this is the first time I can remember it feeling this heavy and lasting like this. I don’t want to overstate it, but… yes, I think this is the first time at this level.
Have you had any other episodes of depression in your life that were similar to what you're experiencing now?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had rough times before, but nothing that really feels similar to this. At least not that I can remember clearly. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you had any significant improvement in your mood for more than two months since this depressive period started?

No… I don’t think I’ve had a stretch like that. It’s kind of been hanging around for about five months now — like this depressed, guilty fog. It did get a lot worse after I bought the condo, but I don’t think there’s been more than a couple months where I really felt significantly better. Does that make sense?
Have you had any episodes of depression before the past five months that felt similar to what you're experiencing now?

No… I don’t think I had anything before this that felt like this. This kind of depressed, guilty fog has been going on about five months. It got worse after I bought the condo, but before that, I can’t really point to another episode like this. Does that answer it?
Have you had more than one episode of depression in your lifetime?

I don’t think so… I mean, I’ve definitely had bad days or stressful periods, but if you mean a real episode like this one, I can’t really say there’s been more than one. This feels like the main time I’ve dealt with something like this. Is that the kind of answer you’re looking for?
Have you had two or more episodes of depression in your lifetime?

I don’t think so, no. I mean… not two full episodes, at least not that I’d call the same as this. I’ve had normal rough times, but this is the only one that really feels like an actual depressive period to me. Is that clear enough?
Have you had any episodes of depression before this one that a doctor or therapist diagnosed or treated?

No, I haven’t had anything before this that was diagnosed or treated by a doctor or therapist. I mean, I’ve never really gone in for depression before now, so… no official episode or treatment that I can think of. Does that make sense?
Have you had any episodes of depression prior to the past five months that were treated by a mental health professional?

No, I don’t think so. Before these last few months, I wasn’t seeing anyone for depression or anything like that. I mean, I had normal stress, but nothing I got treated for by a mental health professional. Is that what you mean?
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt similarly depressed before the past five months?

Not really, no. I mean, I’ve had times where I was stressed or down, like anyone, but nothing before these past five months that felt similar to this. At least, not that I’d describe that way. Is that okay?
Have you had any episodes of depression that lasted for two weeks or more before the past five months?

No, I don’t think I’ve had anything like that before these past five months. I’ve had a bad day here and there, or maybe a rough week, but not two weeks or more where I felt depressed like this. At least not that I can remember.
